arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-01-31' AND date < '2019-02-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated 31 January 2019, labelled or not.
assumptions: Date 31 January 2019 means the full day from 2019-01-31 00:00:00 up to but not including 2019-02-01.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label.
